meta.title: Every GST slab (0, 5, 12, 18, 28 %) is applied to the right line
gaps: The available setup recipes cannot create five quoted lines across three vendors with GST slabs of 0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, and 28%.
No operation can configure per-line GST rates or create a third vendor bid.
No read-back field or assertion vocabulary exposes line totals or GST calculations, so the expected formula cannot be verified.
